crossRefs.note: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to Yahweh your God’s…
Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

translations.web: Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.
translations.bsb: Indeed, you may eat it as you would eat a gazelle or deer; both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it.
translations.kjv: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.
translations.asv: Even as the gazelle and as the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat thereof: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof alike.
